data.name: DemoMetadataDescriptionLong
data.value:
About the game

Explore a made-up world full of abandoned cities, mysterious machines and quiet forests. You collect parts, build your own camp and meet characters who each have a story of their own.

  • Large world: more than twenty areas you can visit in any order.
  • Your own camp: build, furnish and invite friends.
  • Calm music and weather that changes over time 🌧️
Learn more
